## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or CLI tool you are proposing.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a specific workflow friction or problem?
*e.g., "I'm always struggling to generate X during Y phase..."*

## 💡 Proposed Solution & API
Describe how you imagine the CLI command, generator script, or automation tool working.

```bash
# Example CLI invocation
agentway <new-command> [options]
```

## 🏗️ Downstream Impact
- Which of the 9 domains does this benefit?
- How does this save developer/agent time or improve accuracy?

## 📋 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
